description: Send your Handoff proposals, invoices and client emails from an address on your own domain, so your clients see your business as the sender instead of ours.
variableDescription: dkim1, dkim2 and dkim3 are the three DKIM tokens Amazon SES issues for this domain. Each token names its own record and that record's target, so a record can only point at the Amazon SES DKIM key for the same token.
